05 · Logo
Strength meets movement.
The lion symbol
Strength · Leadership · Confidence · Protection · Presence · Pride. Built to work on its own, without the wordmark.
The italic wordmark
Movement · Speed · Performance · Automotive influence · Modern production · Forward momentum.
The lion that makes brands stand out. Over time, customers should recognise the lion alone as Signsnwraps.

11 · Colour ratio
60 · 30 · 10. Never 50/50.
Blue is the recognition colour. Use it sparingly so it's remembered.
60% Ice Blue + Mist Grey — backgrounds
30% White — cards, content
10%
10% Electric Blue — CTAs, logo, highlights.
Electric blue says
Energy · technology · confidence · precision · modernity · performance
Light + navy ink says
Clean · open · approachable · professional · easy to read. Black only for one-colour print.
Together
Performance + Precision + Premium

13
13 · Imagery & graphics
Bright, sharp, premium and real.
Photography
Vehicles · signage installs · material close-ups · PPF application · vinyl wrapping · workshop and install teams · before/after transformations · finished storefronts · material samples
Avoid generic stock photos.
Vehicle angles
Front ¾ · rear ¾ · side profile · detail shots · wrap finish close-ups · PPF edges · finished vehicle in controlled lighting
Blue appears as an environmental accent — never by recolouring the vehicle.
Graphic style
Use: horizontal lines, angular shapes, large type, light ice-blue and grey backgrounds, blue accents, sharp crops, subtle diagonals.
Avoid: circles, pastels, cute illustrations, heavy gradients, random decoration.
Icons: simple line icons, consistent stroke, blue or navy on light.

21
21 · Applications
Lion, blue and light — everywhere.
Storefront · Laverton North
Black/charcoal exterior, large electric-blue logo. Inside: ice-blue and grey walls, white workspaces, blue accents, material sample displays.
Workshop
Wordmark and lion on the walls, with “Plan. Create. Transform.” or “Built to Stand Out.”
Uniforms
Black polo, small lion on chest, large logo on back. Alternative: black hoodie. Keep it simple.
Vehicles
Black vehicle, electric-blue logo. Alternative: white vehicle with blue + black. No full-blue wraps outside campaigns.
Business cards
Front: ice blue with the lion. Back: white, navy details, blue accents. Minimal.
Documents & quotes
Primary logo on proposals, quotes, email signatures. One-colour black on invoices and formal paperwork.
